tagline: LlamaIndex store wrappers that spin up Docker containers automatically — one import swap away.
one_sentence: Drop-in LlamaIndex store replacements that auto-provision Docker containers on localhost URLs and pass through transparently to remote endpoints.
primary_user_persona: Python developer building RAG or GraphRAG pipelines with LlamaIndex who wants to prototype locally without manually managing Docker containers.
key_features: One import swap — same class name, same kwargs as LlamaIndex originals
Automatic localhost detection: Docker container starts when URL resolves to localhost
Passthrough mode: cloud/remote URLs skip Docker entirely
Context manager support for automatic container teardown
